title: The tarnished locket, found early in the Vale ('a name scratched into the tin: MAREN. Someone in the Reach will know it.'), never surfaced a matching NPC or turn-in location across a full 625-turn run through the Vale, Fenmarch, Hollowbrook, the Fallows, the Shieldings, Wardmoor and Marrowgate — the promise reads confident but the payoff (if one exists) was never signposted anywhere I could find.
